name: leftovers
description: Tracks the processes Claude's Bash calls leave running, and has Claude close or explain them. /leftovers lists them.

onLeftover.title: When a turn ends with leftovers
onLeftover.description: follow-up starts one more turn at once for Claude to stop them or say why they stay; note tells Claude at its next turn; off only lists them in /leftovers.

ignore.title: Never report
ignore.description: A JavaScript regular expression; a leftover whose command line matches it is listed but never reported. Empty reports everything.
